title: 船舶柴油電力推進
summary: 追蹤柴油電力推進的發電、配電、變流與馬達損失，建立不同工作點的能量閉合。 在柴油電力能量流實驗室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Track generation, distribution, conversion and motor losses across diesel-electric operating points. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Diesel-electric energy-flow laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 柴油輸入與可用能量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Diesel input and available energy: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 柴油輸入與可用能量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Diesel input and available energy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶柴油電力推進」的「柴油輸入與可用能量」中，燃料質量率需由輸出功率除效率與低位熱值。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：追蹤柴油電力推進的發電、配電、變流與馬達損失，建立不同工作點的能量閉合。
steps.instructionEn: Within Diesel-electric ship propulsion, Diesel input and available energy examines this mechanism: Fuel mass rate follows output power divided by efficiency and lower heating value. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Track generation, distribution, conversion and motor losses across diesel-electric operating points.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：P=500 kW，η=0.42，LHV=42 MJ/kg。關係式 ṁ=P/(ηLHV)；含單位換算算式 500*3600/(0.42*42000) = 102.040816 kg/h。適用條件：單一燃料等效能量帳，不是雙燃料切換或供氣操作。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Output 500 kW, efficiency 0.42 and LHV 42 MJ/kg. Relation ṁ=P/(ηLHV); expression including unit conversion 500*3600/(0.42*42000) = 102.040816 kg/h. Applicability: Single-fuel equivalent energy balance, not fuel-switching or gas-supply operation.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：把燃料體積比例當能量比例會造成偏差。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Treating fuel volume fraction as energy fraction creates bias. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「柴油輸入與可用能量」，對每種燃料分列質量與熱值，再按能量相加。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Diesel input and available energy, List mass and LHV separately for each fuel and sum their energies. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「柴油輸入與可用能量」比較基準算式 500*3600/(0.42*42000) 與替代算式 500*3600/(0.38*42000)。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 112.781955 kg/h，與基準 102.040816 kg/h 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。
knowledge.textEn: For Diesel input and available energy, compare baseline expression 500*3600/(0.42*42000) with alternative 500*3600/(0.38*42000). Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 112.781955 kg/h, versus baseline 102.040816 kg/h. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「船舶柴油電力推進」的「柴油輸入與可用能量：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Diesel input and available energy: Mechanism and observation” in “Diesel-electric ship propulsion”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

knowledge.textEn: For Generator/converter/motor efficiency, compare baseline expression 0.94*0.97*0.95 with alternative 0.94*0.97*0.90. Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 0.82062 1, versus baseline 0.86621 1. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
三段95%效率的總效率仍是95%。
本單元先檢查以下替代原因：以平均效率相加取代相乘會高估鏈效率。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Three 95% stages still yield 95% overall.
First examine this alternative cause: Averaging efficiencies instead of multiplying overestimates chain efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：以平均效率相加取代相乘會高估鏈效率。 對「發電變流馬達串聯效率」，沿能量流逐段標輸入與輸出，避免重複扣損。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
quiz.explanationEn: First examine this alternative cause: Averaging efficiencies instead of multiplying overestimates chain efficiency. For Generator/converter/motor efficiency, Label input/output at each energy-flow stage and avoid double-counting losses. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
